ValidationRule.description: If Case Status is other than "New" then Case Description is mandatory.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (ISBLANK(Description), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Status,'New')), NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name ,'Nexus Data Loader')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'US')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Description field cannot be empty. Please provide case description.
